name: Endou Kotoko
source:
Kotoko is the student council president of the school and also the senpai of [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuuki[/url]. Even if she looks serious, she's also very childish. She likes being called "Kotoko-senpai" by her juniors. One of her hobbies is massaging [url=https://vndb.org/c21994]Yuumi's[/url] breasts, and Kotoko also loves teasing other people.

Like the majority of the students, she knows Yuuki because of his "incident" with [url=https://vndb.org/c21991]Aya-sensei[/url].

[spoiler]In Kotoko's route, after teasing Yuuki too much about his unrequired love for Aya-sensei, he gives his "ring" to her. She accepts it and tells him that it will surely make Aya-sensei jealous if she actually loves him.

Despite her popularity, a lot of the boys in their school do not dare give their "ring" to Kotoko because, according to the rumors, giving it away is a very serious gesture. According to the same rumors Kotoko has never accepted a "ring" before which is wrong, because she already accepted "rings" of several boys in the past. However, Kotoko always got bored of them after going on dates with them, so she never accepted their feelings.

In reality, Kotoko is insensitive to love and doesn't understand how it manifests itself. One time a boy she was dating offered her a beautiful necklace and she gave it back thinking that the "ring" was already enough. The boy ran away in tears, and she still doesn't know why.[/spoiler]
